episodes.synopsis: One week after the events of last season, psychic Kusuo Saiki hopes to return to his normal life. Except, life is very far from normal, as always.
episodes.title: Restarting! Everyday Life, “As Usual” + Another Christmas Challenge! + First Experiences of the Year Are Important + Courtside Love Game + Dessert Buffet Disaster

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo's parents celebrate their wedding anniversary but he ignores them. The next day, he makes a mistake that puts all of their futures in danger.
episodes.title: Firsthand Science Fiction + 'Sup! Love Challenge + Fashion Sense out of Stock

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo and his friends brave the bitter cold to go to school but it's freezing inside. Just as things look really bad, a warmhearted savior arrives.
episodes.title: Midwinter Disaster + The Saiko Conglomerate Home Visit + Come On Over to Saiko Land! + Invincible Disaster Prevention Measures + Congratulations on Your Graduation!

episodes.synopsis: Cute new student Imu Rifuta's appearance has the schoolboys psyched up. But Kokomi stands in the way of her dominance of school cuteness.
episodes.title: The Disastrous Life of Imu Rifuta + April Fools' Deceit! + Spring's Ultimate Weapon + Recycle! Trash Cleanup Competition + Cutting Through the Silence, the Ghost in the Music Room

episodes.synopsis: Kokomi may have knocked Imu down, but she's not out yet. Sensing her rival likes Kusuo, she goes after him. Oddly, this is exactly what he wants...?
episodes.title: Rematch! Rifuta vs Teruhashi + Gifts of the Magi + The Lost Hamster with a Kansai Dialect + The Transient Miniature Animal + Massage Disaster

episodes.synopsis: Metori plans a luxurious weekend cruise to his private island, but the yacht taking everyone there has some unforeseen (Saiki) issues leaving them stranded on a deserted island.
episodes.title: The Saiko Conglomerate's Luxurious Cruise + The Shipwreck of Saiki K. (Part 1)

episodes.synopsis: The classmates are still stuck on the island but manage to complete a raft. Metori demands they decide who will ride and who gets to stay behind.
episodes.title: The Shipwreck of Saiki K. (Part 2) + The PK Academy Press Club Guillotine + Farewell! The Last Day of Summer Break

episodes.synopsis: Sexy student Mikoto Aiura transfers in and impresses everyone with her fortunetelling. Kusuo realizes she may be the real deal and thus his rival.
episodes.title: A Totally Bad News Transfer Student Appears! + Escape the Aural Sight! + The Circumstances of Delicate Children + Another Time Leap Challenge! + The Disastrous Life of Kokomi Teruhashi

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo's managed to escape identification by Mikoto by hiding his aura, but she's not about to give up on her search for the mysterious "S. K."
episodes.title: Psychics Should Exercise Extreme Caution + The Psychic Circus of Dreams + Hope You Get Well Soon!

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo's grandfather Kumagoro gets a suspicious call asking for money and quickly realizes it's a scam. He asks Kusuo for help with revenge.
episodes.title: Preventing a Scam! + The Saiki Family Reunion! + The Rural Mad Scientist + PK Academy Psykickers Assemble!

episodes.synopsis: Riki Nendo gets a love letter from a freshman coed and Kusuo figures it's a prank, but he soon realizes she's serious. Nendo, being Nendo, wants to say no.
episodes.title: An Ugly Bolt Out of the Blue + Conceal Your Hidden Power! + A Fight Between the Two Worst People + A Miraculously Average Guy Appears! + Disaster in the Library Room

episodes.synopsis: In order to win against school idol Kokomi, Imu attempts to profess her love for Kusuo. Riki's pet hamster wreaks havoc inside the school.
episodes.title: A Strong Declaration of Friendship + The Best Wing Girl!? + The Adventures of Riki Jr. No. 2, Small and Smart + The Disastrous Life of Hiroshi Satou + Trim a Bit off the Sides

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo and Mikoto visit Chisato, who's working new jobs to save up enough money to visit her dad in Puerto Rico. But Mikoto soon divines a surprise.
episodes.title: Chisato Mera's Reunion + An Abnormality with Silent Cyborg + The Ultimate Spot Claimers + Preface to the Final Episode

episodes.synopsis: Forced to survive for 24 hours without relying on his rich family, Metori Saiko enlists the help of Riki and the others.
episodes.title: The Saiko Family's Greatest Trial + Psychic Sidekicks + The Occult Club's Final Scream Scheme + Love Score Showdown + The Master Artist's Classroom

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo and his friends decide to follow Riki after hearing that he is going to go help the Baseball Club, which results in one cliché after another.
episodes.title: Rebuilding the Baseball Team! + Eat Your Vegetables Too! The Yakiniku Epilogue + Dad's New Job!? + Birthday Present Demands

episodes.synopsis: Imu begs Kusuo to help her find a suitable boy before she goes absolutely crazy over Kokomi. Self-professed "love-master" Chiyo steps in to help.
episodes.title: If You're Looking for a Boyfriend... + The Best Present for a Beloved Sister + The Spirit Medium Debuts Again + The High Tech Soldier, 100 Yen Man! + Inside the Secret Base

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo receives an explosive surprise from his brother Kusuke, who has a challenge for him. If Kusuo fails, Kusuke will expose him as a psychic to the world via firework.
episodes.title: He's Back! The Brother's Five Directives + Let's Go to the Zoo! + The Disastrous Work of a New Manga Author + The Disastrous Lives of the Kaidou Brothers + A Girl's Makeover

episodes.synopsis: New student Touma Akechi joins the class but there's something about him that's different from the other transfers, besides his extreme verbosity.
episodes.title: Touma Akechi, the Transfer Student Who Never Shuts Up + The Transfer Student's Still Talking! + Sweet Potato Digging Disaster + Putting the Mascot Characters in Order + Metori Saiko's Listless Days

episodes.synopsis: The school festival is coming up and Kusuo's class must pick a boy-girl pair to volunteer, setting the stage for an intense battle of wits.
episodes.title: Class Disaster + PK Academy Cultural Festival

episodes.synopsis: After accidentally turning Riki and Shun into stone, Kusuo comes up with a plan to hypnotically substitute them with other friends. Hilarity ensues.
episodes.title: Impersonation via Hypnosis + High Expectations on the New, Fully Functional Mascot + This Year's the Last Time! New Year's Eve + Silent New Year's

episodes.synopsis: Kusuo's grandparents are visiting but get delayed on the way to the house. Luckily, or perhaps unluckily, his friends soon find them and try to help.
episodes.title: Chronicles of the Grandparents' Travels + Returning the Favor, Toritsuka's Ascetic Fasting + A Misunderstanding Between Opposite Sex Friends + A Big Scoop!

episodes.synopsis: After getting blamed alongside his friends when they cause trouble, Kusuo vows to go home alone the next day. But then Kineshi insists on joining him.
episodes.title: Choosing the Best Person to Walk Home With + Details Wanted! The Super Idol's Secret + Division of Labor + Facing the Unexpected

episodes.synopsis: With Touma Akechi about to find out his secret, Kusuo goes back in time to elementary school to keep Touma from even suspecting that Kusuo has psychic powers.
episodes.title: Facing an Unusual Past

episodes.synopsis: Kokomi's beauty and kindness are admired by all but her efforts spark some unexpected actions among her male classmates, leading to trouble.
episodes.title: Trial of the Perfect Beautiful Girl + Make Your Investigation, Psykickers! + Disaster Back from the Holidays + Remembering the Cast
